name: Hush Feeds Web Client (TypeScript)
notes: Active web producer; compressed addresses are the current UI surface. 24-word generated; 12-word accepted via BIP-39 standard library. Seed: BIP-39 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 2048; HKDF-SHA256 info 'signing'/'encryption'; 32-byte output used directly as private scalar (no retry path documented).
signatureBehavior: ECDSA-SHA256 prehash of exact UTF-8 canonical transaction JSON bytes; compact 64-byte r||s; base64 in UserSignature.Signature; deterministic RFC 6979 nonce
